name: codetracker
description: A VSCode extension to track and record your coding activity

csvalley.electronPort.description: Port number of the CS Valley Electron desktop application's local server.
csvalley.electronPort.markdownDescription: The **port number** on `localhost` where the CS Valley Electron desktop application's local server is listening for activity reports. **Must match the port configured in your Electron app.**

csvalley.reportPath.description: HTTP POST endpoint path on the Electron app for activity reports.
csvalley.reportPath.markdownDescription: The **HTTP POST path** on the Electron app's local server where activity reports should be sent. E.g., `/api/report`. **Must match the route configured in your Electron app.**

csvalley.reportThrottleMs.description: General throttling interval for sending reports to the Electron app (in milliseconds).
csvalley.reportThrottleMs.markdownDescription: The **general throttling interval** in milliseconds before activity reports are sent to the Electron app. This helps prevent overwhelming the local server with too many requests.

csvalley.codingActivityDebounceMs.description: Idle timeout before coding activity is considered paused (in milliseconds).
csvalley.codingActivityDebounceMs.markdownDescription: The **idle timeout** in milliseconds. If no edit or save happens during this window, CS Valley pauses coding-duration accumulation.

csvalley.codingDurationReportIntervalMs.description: Interval for sending coding-duration increments to the Electron app (in milliseconds).
csvalley.codingDurationReportIntervalMs.markdownDescription: The **coding-duration report interval** in milliseconds while the user is actively editing.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
